name: scholar-highlights
description: Browser extension that colour-codes Google Scholar author profile pages by the profile owner's authorship role, co-first included, with filters and recomputed metrics.
author: Ningfeng Que
comment: No dependencies, by design: the extension is shipped as plain files, there is no build step, and the test suite uses only the Node standard library.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node tests/run.js && node scripts/check-manifest-parity.mjs
